['Intel Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Intel Deutschland GmbH operates as a wireless semiconductor business and is headquartered in Neubiberg, Germany. It is a subsidiary of Intel Corporation, a multinational technology company known for being one of the world's largest semiconductor chip manufacturers.

['Otto Fuchs KG '].company_description: Otto Fuchs KG operates in the non-ferrous metal industry and is involved in processes such as forging, extrusion, ring rolling, and additive manufacturing. The company has sites in Germany, Hungary, China, South America, and the US. They are known for their unrivaled quality standards and have a diverse range of divisions.
